title: Edmund and the Protocol
author: Casper Amberdale
blurb: Freya Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
